description: This file contains the implementation of prepacking functions for quantized convolution operations using cuDNN in PyTorch. It includes template functions for 2D convolution weight packing, validation checks, and registration of prepacking routines for different convolution configurations, specifically targeting CUDA with cuDNN support.
